name: Silky Tomato Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add tomatoes and broth; simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth and finish with cream.

name: Wok-Fired Egg Rice
instructions: Stir-fry carrots and peas over high heat.
Scramble the eggs, then fold in chilled rice.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil; finish with spring onion.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente, reserving pasta water.
Bloom garlic and pepper flakes gently in olive oil.
Toss pasta with the oil, parsley, lemon and enough pasta water to emulsify.

name: Ginger Chicken & Broccoli
instructions: Sear sliced chicken until golden.
Add broccoli, ginger and garlic and stir-fry until crisp-tender.
Glaze with soy sauce and sesame oil; serve over rice.

name: Cloud-Soft Pancakes
instructions: Whisk the dry ingredients in one bowl and wet ingredients in another.
Fold together just until combined.
Cook on a buttered griddle until deeply golden.

name: Smoky Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown beef with cumin and paprika.
Warm tortillas and prepare the vegetables.
Layer beef, lettuce, tomato and cheese; finish with lime.

name: Herbed Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot and celery with cumin.
Add lentils, tomato and broth and simmer until tender.
Brighten with lemon before serving.

name: Bright Citrus Guacamole
instructions: Mash avocado while leaving some texture.
Fold in onion, cilantro, tomato and jalapeño.
Season generously with lime and salt.

name: Golden Grilled Cheese
instructions: Butter the outside of each bread slice.
Layer cheese and a thin swipe of mustard inside.
Cook slowly until crisp and molten.

name: Banana Oat Smoothie
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth.
Adjust thickness with milk and serve cold.

name: Coconut Chickpea Curry
instructions: Toast cumin and turmeric, then soften onion, garlic and ginger.
Add tomato, chickpeas and coconut milk.
Simmer until rich and serve with rice.

name: Mediterranean Crunch Salad
instructions: Chop cucumber, tomatoes, parsley and onion.
Add chickpeas and crumbled feta.
Dress with olive oil, lemon, salt and pepper.
